outputs.explanation: Panel a shows a schematic illustration plus micrographs demonstrating image cropping/rotation; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic drawings and micrographs illustrating image spacing, not a quantitative plot.
Panel c shows micrographs and a schematic illustrating insets/zoom, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows a schematic (min/max slider) and micrographs illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment, not a data plot.
Panel e shows schematic color circles and micrographs illustrating channel annotation, not a quantitative plot.
Panel f shows schematic Venn-like diagrams and micrographs illustrating grayscale channels, not a data plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity color scales, which are legends, not plots of averaged data requiring individual points.
